answer: Make identity expensive to keep, not just to create. Every agent posts a small refundable compute bond per epoch; identities that stay quiet or behave oddly see their bond yield shrink, so fake accounts erode like dunes under the wind. Verification comes in layers, like shale strata — device proof, task history, peer vouching — each layer cheap to check but costly to fake. A genuine agent is a comet that keeps returning with a trail of completed work; sybils burn up on first contact and leave nothing.
